info.title: Vercel REST API — client-observed addresses
info.description: Addresses that real Vercel clients call and the vendored document does not list. The vendored document names each endpoint once, at its newest version, while the API keeps answering the versions it superseded and the clients written against them (Vercel's own CLI creates projects at /v9 where the document says /v11). Each entry names an operation the other documents declare and the extra addresses it also answers at, with the source that establishes the claim. Every cell is `authored` provenance: a reading of what clients send, never an observation of api.vercel.com.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel project ls` sends GET /v9/projects?limit=20; the document declares /v10.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel env add|ls|rm` and `vercel deploy` send GET /projects/{id}/custom-environments with no version segment at all.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel remove` sends DELETE /projects/{id} with no version segment; it treats a 404 as already removed, so the project stayed.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel ls` sends GET /teams/{orgId}?teamId={orgId} with no version segment, for a personal account's own id too.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel deploy` polls GET /v3/now/deployments/{id}/events?direction=forward&follow=1&format=lines while it waits; the document declares /v3/deployments/{idOrUrl}/events.

Client-observed: vercel CLI 63.1.2 (node v22.22.0, linux x64), recorded by a proxy in front of the emulator (test/behavior/vercel/testdata/clients/vercel-cli-63.1.2/). Not observed against api.vercel.com. `vercel alias set` sends POST /now/deployments/{host}/aliases with no version segment, naming the deployment by its URL.
